history.sg_progress: The development of the policy framework for the performance management of resident coordinators and United Nations country teams has been initiated. Through collaboration with colleagues from across the United Nation system, the first step has resulted in the development of the resident coordinator competency framework, which will underpin the new performance management system. The performance management of the staff of resident coordinators’ offices is under the scope of the Secretariat’s administrative instruction on the performance management and development system (ST/AI/2010/5 and ST/AI/2010/5/Corr.1).

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration expedite the development of a permanent system for the performance management of resident coordinators, which should reflect and be aligned with their revamped role.
history.administration_response: The development of the policy framework for the performance management of resident coordinators and United Nations country teams is ongoing, in parallel with capturing lessons learned from the 2019–2020 results of the transitional performance appraisal system, the roll-out of a peer feedback tool to capture United Nations country team member inputs on resident coordinator performance and the design of the permanent resident coordinator/ United Nations country team performance management system, all in consultation with a United Nations Sustainable Development Group task force on resident coordinator/United Nations country team performance management. The development of the policy framework is envisioned to be completed by the end of 2021.
history.board_assessment: Given that the development of a policy framework for the performance management of resident coordinators and United Nations country teams is ongoing, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration expedite the development of a permanent system for the performance management of resident coordinators, which should reflect and be aligned with their revamped role.
history.administration_response: The first draft of the administrative instruction has been prepared and the work between the Development Coordination Office and the Office of Human Resources and the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance has been initiated.
history.board_assessment: Given that the recommendation had been reiterated and refined in 2020, the process of promulgating the permanent system for the appraisal of resident coordinators is still under way and the system is envisioned to enter into force in 2023, the Board considers this recommendation as having been over taken by events.
